parallel_timing.reason: Author-requested fixed single-thread pool; 8 through 2200 nt, 4 from 3600 nt; one worker when 32 GiB/process is required. Split long methods to preserve explicit censoring budgets.

cost_model.basis: Explicit process timeout ceiling, no length extrapolation; parallel packing uses blocked_random_timeout_bound

parallel_packing.basis: Preserve first-pending launch order: charge all warmups serially plus three measured list bounds work/w+(1-1/w)*largest_job; 120 s staging/checkpoint allowance
